scope: Two authenticated real GitHub syncs of the user-authorised own public repository in an isolated expiring judge workspace. Existing accounts/provider settings untouched; temporary connection/token revoked after checks.
limitations: Own public repository only, not arbitrary private-repository permissions.
Bounded recent history and selected files; partial status is not complete repository history.
No intentional live GitHub outage; failure/retry contract cases are tested locally.
Not an independent human usability test.
inventory_check: The API intentionally omits connection_id from source summaries. The initial checker filtered that absent field and reported zero; this was a checker error, not an import failure. Import evidence is the job stats: 40 initial imports and zero new imports on resync. No source-body read was needed.
